title: implementer
description: One implementer run on a task: commits, a question round, or a hand-off. Set outcome, then only the fields that go with it.

outcome.description: commits: the change is committed in the clone; set title and summary. question: a criterion is ambiguous; set questions. handoff: an action only the owner can do blocks the task; set handoff.

title.description: With outcome commits: the PR title, <type>: <sentence>. The daemon joins the two.

type.description: One of the preamble's title types, as it's written there.

sentence.description: A short sentence on what the change does, in one line, without the type.

summary.description: With outcome commits: the PR's summary of the change.

what_changed.description: A few lines of Markdown, without headings: what the commits change.

why.description: A few lines of Markdown, without headings: why, against the task's criteria.

tests_added.description: The tests you added, one line each. Empty for none.

tests_updated.description: The tests you changed, one line each. Empty for none.

questions.description: With outcome question: this round's questions, most blocking first.

text.description: The question, in one line that stands alone.

blocks.description: The issue numbers the question blocks.

recommended.description: The option you recommend, listed first.

why.description: Why you recommend it, in one line.

others.description: The other options, one line each.

handoff.description: With outcome handoff: the hand-off for the owner, every field filled. If you can't fill one, ask a question instead.

goal.description: One sentence: what the owner's action achieves.

why_blocks.description: What the task waits for, and why, in one line that reads on after "can't proceed until". Don't name the task: the daemon puts its number first.

steps.description: Markdown: exact actions, with exact values, commands or settings, as a numbered list, in order.

links.description: Markdown: direct links to the console page, file or doc, as a list.

done_when.description: The observable result the owner can check, in one line.
